message: Hey Jane, how have you been? I've been thinking about you and Ethan. Hope everything is going well. Let's catch up soon!
Hi Jane, Ethan showed some remarkable progress in today's session at Bright Horizons. However, he's still struggling with transitions. Let's discuss strategies in our next meeting.
Dr. Bennett, thank you for the update. I've noticed the same with my adult son at home. Looking forward to our meeting.
Jane, that quiche recipe you shared was amazing! The spinach and cheese combo was a hit with my kids too. Thanks!
Glad to hear that! It's become a favorite in our house as well. I'll share more recipes soon.
Jane, I saw a new therapy center opened up nearby. It's called Bright Horizons. Have you heard of it?
Yes, Lisa, my adult son Ethan has been going there for his behavioral therapy. It's a wonderful place with caring staff.
That's great to hear! I hope it's helping him. Let's plan a day to meet up soon.
Definitely, Lisa. It's been too long. I'll check my schedule and get back to you.
Reminder: Ethan's next session is on Thursday at 2 PM. Please ensure he has a light meal beforehand.
